title: Dos & Don'ts / Schwelle
slide_intent: Make permitted changes explicit so the signature stays recognizable across varied uses.
strategic_value: A concise comparison can prevent DB’s bar element from drifting into unrelated shapes.
demonstration: Five positive/negative pairs cover orientation, edge shape, stretching, color and the number of elements.
practical_value: Check cardinal orientation, straight edges, allowed stretching/colors and one-element usage.

content_islands.name: Orientation and edges
content_islands.spec: Contrast horizontal/vertical straight bars with crossed-out diagonal and softened versions.

content_islands.name: Stretch and color
content_islands.spec: Compare allowed extension and defined colors with compressed or off-palette treatments.

content_islands.name: Quantity
content_islands.spec: Compare a single sequence with an additional subtle background sequence.

reference_purposes.Constraint: Only horizontal/vertical placement, straight edges and defined colors are allowed; length may stretch to 200% but not compress; at most one Schwelle per layout or viewport.
reference_purposes.Application: Positive and crossed-out specimens make each restriction directly comparable.
